findings: Owner request 2026-11-09: practice long questions for Chapter 12 in the same format as Chapter 1 (English and Roman Urdu), written from the chapter; not printed in the book. 28 questions numbered 1-28; by section: 12.1 2, 12.2 2, 12.3 4, 12.4 8, 12.5 2, 12.6 2, 12.7 2, 12.8 2, 12.9 2, 12.12 2.

14 pairs (theory 5 marks + numerical 3 marks) covering the nucleus and the unified mass unit, the four fundamental forces, anti-particles and pair production, annihilation, radioactivity and the three radiations, alpha decay and the Q-value, beta-minus and beta-plus decay, the energy spectra and gamma emission, fundamental particles with hadrons and leptons, quarks and colour, the Higgs boson and force carriers, conservation laws, the matter-antimatter asymmetry with plasma, and the theories of forces with the Standard Model. The chapter has no derivations; its equations (N = A − Z, decay equations, quark charge sums, 2m₀c² = 1.02 MeV) appear in the theory answers. Numericals use new values, recomputed in Python; nuclide masses and c are stated in the questions. Book corrections followed: proton uud, Z is the atomic number, nucleon number A, Higgs boson not a force carrier; 12.10's misprinted percentages and the neutron half-life are not used.
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
Drafts for the academic review (second-person review before publication).
